description: This file defines the RegistrationClientFactory interface in the 'org.eclipse.hono.client' package, providing factory methods to create registration client instances for Hono's Device Registration API, with support for connection management and optional caching.

classes.name: RegistrationClientFactory
classes.description: An interface for a factory that creates clients for Hono's Device Registration API, supporting connection lifecycle management and tenant-specific registration clients.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create a factory for an existing connection without caching.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create a factory for an existing connection with an optional cache provider.

methods.name: getOrCreateRegistrationClient
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a registration client for the specified tenant, returning a Future that completes with the client.
